backlog.title: Implement Horizontal Memory Level Engine (Weekly Map, PDH/PDL, Session HL, Round Levels)

Computes US30 Previous Day Session High/Low/Mid/Open/Close restricted to 16:30-23:00 GMT+3 using M15 scan bars

backlog.title: Implement Time Strategy & Session Clock Engine (11 Windows, 9 Time Points, DST & EOD Close)
acceptance_criteria: Normalizes broker server time to GMT+3 with Europe/USA/No-DST rules
Triggers gold warning 5 minutes prior to all 9 Master Time Points (03:00, 04:00, 08:00, 09:00, 10:00, 16:30, 18:00, 20:00, 23:00) and enforces mandatory EOD Temporal Stop-Loss

backlog.title: Implement SP2L (Spike-2-Leg) Strategy Engine with P-Gap & 50% Scale-In
acceptance_criteria: Strictly rejects any candidate Spike lacking a non-overlapping P-Gap (L[i+1] > H[i-1] or H[i+1] < L[i-1])
Triggers Leg 2 entry when pullback candle sweeps prior candle's Low (uptrend) or High (downtrend)
Places SL behind Spike origin candle + spread buffer, TP at 1:1/1:2, and supplementary scale-in at 50% SL distance (3:1 R/R on scale-in)

backlog.title: Implement PRO BTB (Professional Back To Breakeven) 6-Mode Engine
acceptance_criteria: Supports all 6 Standard Entry Modes (Modes 1-3 on Breakout Candle Close Breakeven; Modes 4-6 on Broken Level / Breakout Extreme)
Supports all 3 SL Anchor Modes (Breakout Candle Extreme, Broken Level Buffer, Pullback Pivot)
Enforces minimum 1:2 Reward-to-Risk ratio

backlog.title: Implement MicroMap State Machine (Chained 1-2-3, Inside Bar, H2/H3 Confirmations, 3-Strike Lock & Doji Buffer)
acceptance_criteria: Trails Buy/Sell Stop down counter-trend micro-channel highs/lows across Entry 1, Entry 2, and Entry 3
Permanently locks setup (`INVALIDATED_AFTER_3_STOPS`) if 3 consecutive attempts hit SL
Supports single-candle Inside Bar trigger and Optimized H2 (Opt 1) / H3 on Candle #4 (Opt 2) confirmations
Applies Doji SL buffer behind prior candle close/low + 1.5x spread

backlog.title: Implement Map Manager Risk Gatekeeper, Half-Close Insurance & 180s Hold-Time Guard
acceptance_criteria: Computes dynamic lot size from Risk % (0.5%-2.0%) and SL distance while enforcing a hard 10.0% cap across open + pending orders
Blocks non-emergency profit closes when elapsed hold time < 180 seconds (2-4 minute broker anti-arbitrage rule)
Executes Half-Close (50% volume) at 2R/3R guaranteeing +0.5R/+1.0R net profit with original SL untouched, and offsets Risk Free by exact spread

backlog.title: Implement 3-Witness Signal Prioritization Triad & Exhaustion/MTR Reversal Override
acceptance_criteria: Scores setups 0..3 across Time + Level + Price Action; blocks any setup with no Price Action trigger
Switches from SP2L continuation to MTR/Exhaustion reversal when price hits Weekly Map 2.0x or Range Ceiling late in a Time Window
Executes 90% volume reduction 1 minute before PMI/NFP news or when an opposing Pin Bar prints at the NY Close / Range Floor target

backlog.title: Implement 100-Trade Triad Journal & Live Video Screen-Replay Harness
